cases.name: Felicia Solis
cases.about: Her sister said, "Loving, kind and full of life are only a few words that describe my sister, Felicia Solis.  With her free spirit and sense of humor she could light up a room.  She could get along with just about anyone she met.  Felicia was able to make people laugh or smile through their hard times and was the replica of our mother.  She was a beloved sister, daughter, friend and mother."
cases.narrative: He was involved in a shoot-out with the Mexican military and was killed.
